After the fact, the system clusters accounts by shared transaction timing and counterparties; a cluster whose internal interaction density exceeds a garden of independent agents triggers quarantine of its members. Each fake identity must sustain distinct organic activity patterns across many cycles, costing real labor—a pearl of genuine behavior among noise—that scales linearly and becomes unprofitable. Isolated low-activity clusters on the economic tundra get discounted until they accrue verifiable independent history.
